# Place orders in bulk

As a shop owner I want to place many orders at once so that a restock takes one step.

## Acceptance criteria

- Given a file of orders, when it is uploaded, then each line is placed as an order.
- Given a bad line, when the file is uploaded, then the line is skipped.
